data.raw_text:
[9:36PM] #OguduAlapere #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic has eased from Gbagada Bridge and Olopomeji down to Ifako.
Movement from Ifako to Ogudu is slow but steady due to construction at the Ifako/Ogudu link bridge.
After Ifako/Ogudu bridge, movement through Ogudu, Alapere Estate to Apostolic Church is smoother.
From Apostolic Church to Ojota Bridge, Ikosi Junction, and down to Otedola Bridge, traffic is free-flowing. 
The return journey from Otedola Bridge to Secretariat and back to Car Wash is also moving well.

#FollowLASTMA

data.raw_text:
[9:58PM] #Ijanikin #TrafficUpdate 

There is smooth vehicular movement from Abule Ado through Under Bridge, Volks, Afolabi Ege to Iyana Iba, though Iyana Iba intersection is busy due to commercial activities.

Traffic from the intersection toward Igando through First Gate is okay, with slight congestion at Iyana School caused by commercial buses. Movement from Iyana School to Obadore Bridge and the return route is good.

Badagry Expressway from Igbo Elerin Junction through Iyana Isashi and Iyana Era to Customs Checkpoint is flowing well.

In and out of Igbo Elerin is clear, and Afolabi Ege Flyover link to LASU-Isheri is also free.

#FollowLASTMA
